correctness.rationale: The final repaired statement makes the split relative to a chosen band idempotent and defines the two intrinsic ranks on the quotients of the one-sided annihilators by their intersection. The original word 'intrinsic' could assert a canonical splitting: in the 2-by-2 case choosing e_11 versus e_21 changes B from k(e_12−e_11) to k(e_22−e_21), and B and C themselves are generally not one-sided ideals. The numerical and geometric conclusions survive unchanged. In the corrected tensor proof every derivation has form P⊗I+I⊗Q with image of each factor map in its augmentation kernel. Projection and fixed-vector conditions give P²=P, Q²=Q, and then D²−D=2P⊗Q. Eigenvalue sums give the full-operator rank; counting ordered complements and fixed vectors gives the weights. The complementary-subspace varieties are smooth irreducible open subsets of products of Grassmannians; ranks of projections are locally constant and the chosen vectors form tautological bundles. This proves the component statement for the reduced locus, including zero ranks.
residual_risks: The fresh direct computation is binary 2-by-2 only; the proof establishes the other sizes, fields and geometric assertion.
No result is claimed for the scheme structure beyond the reduced locus, nor for higher-rank sandwich algebras.

value.rationale: Rectangular bands give a natural rank-one sandwich family with two independent augmentation directions. The count quantifies exactly how characteristic two permits both induced projections and changes the rank histogram and the number of irreducible components. These exact invariants provide a useful comparison point for other sandwich algebras, without requiring a speculative generalization.
residual_risks: The value is for the complete operator classification, rank law and reduced geometry of this family, not for novelty of the adapted basis or a general sandwich-algebra assertion.
